{{Top}}
A '''cocktail''' was a drink served as of [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. They were served on the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Corellian Queen]]'', where they were sold at a very high price. A [[Sonic Servodriver]] was a cocktail.

Part of [[Galaxy Tours/Legends|Galaxy Tours']] [[Grand Galactic Tour]] involved a gala cocktail party aboard a [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]] while on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
